title: Sony RMT-814 Digital Camcorder Remote - Tested
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:Remote Controls
descriptionText: The Sony RMT-814 Digital Camcorder Remote is specifically designed for Sony camcorders, ensuring compatibility and precise control. With a sleek design and user-friendly interface, this remote allows for easy operation of your digital camcorder. The model number RMT-814 guarantees a perfect fit for your Sony device, making it a convenient and reliable accessory for all your filming needs.
